summary: This research study looks at how a medicine called NNC0487-0111 helps people with excess body weight and knee osteoarthritis, which is a condition involving joint pain and stiffness in the knee. The study is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S and aims to include 400 participants. Patients will receive either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance, given as an injection under the skin once a week. The trial is currently in Phase 3 and its status is Recruiting.
